SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   D. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   C. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   D. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   D. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   C. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   D. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

7. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

9. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat The School as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

10. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

13. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   B. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   D. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

16. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Economic activities in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Industries in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise Project at School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Democracy in school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
